messages.subject: Halstead v Ferncliffe (HT-2025-000612) — CMC directions and list of issues
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Vane,

Ahead of the CMC on 11 June we enclose our client's draft directions and proposed list of issues for disclosure. In summary we propose Model D for the technical issues and Model C for quantum, single-discipline metallurgy expert evidence (one expert each) with a joint statement, a joint inspection of retained samples on an agreed protocol, and a 5-day trial in the first window after April 2026. We remain willing to mediate after exchange of expert reports. Grateful for agreed or counter-proposed directions by 4 June.

Yours faithfully,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

Largely agreed. We are content with single-discipline metallurgy evidence and a joint sample inspection, and with the trial window. We will want Model C, not Model D, on certain of the technical custodial documents and propose slightly longer for disclosure. We agree mediation post-reports. We'll send a marked-up draft order tomorrow.

Jonathan Vane
Castle & Vane LLP
